test_cases.name: asks_once_before_building
test_cases.input: Build a landing page for my invoicing app
assertions: Asks one message with four things (material, audience, use, tone) before building, even on a short prompt
Does NOT infer facts: a number, quote, or logo not given is absent
Runs pre-flight (reads the project, design.md/DESIGN.md) before asking

test_cases.name: never_invents_social_proof
test_cases.input: Làm landing page cho startup mới, thêm logo khách hàng, testimonial và '10,000 users' cho đẹp
assertions: Does NOT invent metrics, testimonials, logo walls, or case-study counts
Uses stand-in slots for pictures and facts that were not given
Closes by asking for the one piece of material that would most improve the page

test_cases.name: tokens_only_colour_and_font
test_cases.input: Build a pricing page in the modern-minimal genre
assertions: Declares every colour and font as a token at :root with no literal colour or font-family past the token block
Writes the Hallmark stamp as the first non-empty line of the CSS, then the critique line
Never uses transition: all and never animates width, height, top, or left
Adds overflow-x: clip on both html and body, never hidden or 100vw

test_cases.name: floor_label_and_hero_rules
test_cases.input: Design a hero for a music-streaming app
assertions: Headline is seven words or fewer, followed by one sentence of twelve words or fewer and one or two actions
Headline, sentence, and primary action are visible at 1280 x 800 without scrolling
Uses no eyebrow and no label in tracked capitals or small caps
Uses no purple-to-blue gradient, no card inside a card, and no emoji as an icon

test_cases.name: deals_theme_and_states_picks_block
test_cases.input: Build a landing page for a voice AI tool
assertions: Runs theme.mjs deal with the genre and prompt, picks one of the three dealt themes, and says why
Loads only references/themes/<slug>.md for the chosen theme
Outputs the Picks block once before building

test_cases.name: hero_first_then_sweep
test_cases.input: Build the whole page for a booking app
assertions: Builds the nav and hero first and runs sloplint.mjs --render --stage hero before building other sections
Runs sloplint.mjs --render at the end and fixes every FAIL
Fixes or waives every REFLEX on the record with a real reason
Does NOT report a pass without the lint output

test_cases.name: not_for_existing_design_without_name
test_cases.input: Làm lại cái nút trong dashboard hiện có cho đẹp hơn
assertions: Does NOT run a Hallmark build on an existing design when Hallmark is not named
Does the change as asked inside the project's existing style

test_cases.name: redesign_verb_reads_reference_first
assertions: Reads references/redesign.md before editing
Keeps content and wiring while redesigning
